title: Position
description: Where one reading lands on one question's axis. A position is OUR READING OF THEIR READING — the commentator never placed themselves on our axis — so `asserted_by` records who made the placement, and `evidence` ties it to actual anchored text. See docs/10-resonance.md.

evidence.description: REQUIRED, at least one. No position exists without an anchored interpretation behind it — that rule is what keeps this from being armchair comparative religion.

asserted_by.description: Who placed this reading on the axis. Never the commentator themselves.

reviewed_by.description: Advisory-group sign-off. Required for positions on high-consequence questions.
